messages:
karen: Quick sync — we need a concrete metrics contract for degraded/fallback flows so Product/Console can build dashboards and SRE can alert. Goal: cover timeouts, 5xx, OOMs, and 'degraded mode' (fallback to smaller model). cc @sam @miguel

sam: +1. We currently emit a few ad-hoc counters from runtime but no unified names/labels. Can we standardize names and minimal label set?

miguel: Proposal (starting point):
```
redwood_request_total{outcome="ok|timeout|5xx|oom|fallback|degraded",service="runtime|proxy",model="gptx-8b",route="/v1/generate",routing_policy="cost|latency"}
redwood_request_latency_seconds_bucket{...}
redwood_fallback_count_total{reason="kv_miss|capacity|policy"}
```
Keep `outcome` as primary dimension so dashboards can stack by outcome.

kara: tiny nit: "degraded" vs "fallback" semantics: degraded = returned result from lighter model/quantized variant; fallback = returned cached response or default text. We should separate them.

karen: Good point. Let's split `outcome` values: ok, timeout, error_5xx, oom, fallback_cached, fallback_model.

tara: We need to avoid high cardinality. `route` and `model` are useful; avoid request-specific labels like `user_id` or full path. Also don't add `prompt_type` until we can guarantee values are bounded.

anya: From Console UX POV we'd like both a service-level summary and a per-route breakdown (top 10 routes by volume). So please emit `route` and `service`, and an optional `route_group` label for grouping.

sam: Agree. Also, for rollouts we need `model_version` label to support canary dashboards. That will increase cardinality but acceptable if it's controlled (versions per model are small).

miguel: Producers: runtime should emit request_total, latency histograms, and fallback_count when it switches to smaller model. Proxy (ingress) should emit timeout/error_5xx counters so we can attribute HTTP vs runtime errors. Autoscaler should emit OOM events as a gauge or counter? Thoughts.

ops-bot: (system) new alert created: basic-error-rate-threshold, owner=@ops-team :bell:

ops: OOMs are tricky — runtime already logs OOMs to journald. I'd prefer a `redwood_oom_events_total{node, model}` counter emitted by runtime when it recovers after OOM. That feeds an alert for spikes.

sam: For alerts, suggested rules: 
```
expr = sum by(service) (increase(redwood_request_total{outcome="error_5xx"}[5m])) / sum by(service) (increase(redwood_request_total[5m])) > 0.02
for: 5m
```
And a separate alert for `fallback_model` rate > 1% sustained.

karen: Good. Also add a graph for 'fallback conversion funnel' showing requests -> fallback_model -> successful_retry. We need a `retry_outcome` metric or rely on labels on subsequent requests.

tara: Telemetry sources need a short doc with emission points, example metrics, and cardinality guidance. Console team can mock panels once we have that.

miguel: One more practical note: prefix metrics with `redwood_` and keep units (seconds for latency, total for counters). Histograms for p50/p95/p99.

anya: UX ask: expose a quick filter in the Console to toggle by `routing_policy` (cost vs latency) and show fallback counts per policy. So include `routing_policy` label when available.

sam: Implementation plan:
- runtime: emit `redwood_request_total`, `redwood_request_latency_seconds_bucket`, `redwood_fallback_count_total`, `redwood_oom_events_total` (owner: @miguel)
- proxy/ingress: emit `redwood_proxy_http_total{status_class=~"2xx|5xx|4xx"}` (owner: @sam)
- autoscaler: emit `redwood_node_oom_gauge` or just rely on `oom_events_total` (owner: @ops)
- docs: telemetry.md with examples and label cardinality (owner: @tara)

karen: Can we commit to metric names and a short example payload this week? I can add to the Console backlog once we have that.

miguel: I'll open a PR with runtime changes and examples today. Will include a small test harness that emits sample series so Grafana can be prototyped.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch: feat/metrics-contracts by miguel — CI: passing :rocket:

anya: Thanks all. Follow-ups: miguel to PR, tara to draft telemetry doc, sam to add alert rules to alerts repo. We'll reconvene in #eng-platform next Wed if needed. :thumbsup:
